purpose: 주년 배지 기본 디자인 5개와 디자인별 4단계 테두리 금속 비교

tiers.appearance: bright cool platinum with subtle icy blue reflections

concepts.name: 사계의 인장
concepts.meaning: 한 해의 사계절을 함께 지나온 기록
concepts.prompt:
Create a polished landscape design comparison sheet, about 2.4:1 aspect ratio, for a Korean gaming clan's physical anniversary collectible enamel pin. Use the attached flag pin ONLY as a reference for craftsmanship: sculpted real metal edges, rich emerald and pale mint enamel, warm ivory, crisp highlights, tangible premium hard-enamel jewelry. Design a completely new anniversary emblem, NOT another flag.
LAYOUT: exactly FOUR large, front-facing pins in one horizontal row, identical scale, silhouette, internal geometry, motif, enamel colors, interior champagne-metal partitions and lighting. Treat them as four exact copies of ONE die mold, with ONLY the broad OUTER BORDER metal material changing, left to right: (1) warm bronze/copper, (2) neutral brushed silver, (3) warm polished gold, (4) bright cool platinum with subtle icy blue highlights. Silver is medium neutral gray; platinum is paler, more luminous, cool near-white, visibly distinguishable. Do not change any ornaments, number of points, interior linework, internal metal colors, textures or enamel colors between tiers. No numerals embedded inside the pins.
PRESENTATION: uniform matte charcoal #151918 background, soft controlled studio light, subtle small contact shadow, generous clear spacing, no badge case, no frame, no distracting scenery, no gradient glow. Every pin should be fully visible and use most of its column. Clean understated Korean sans-serif labels OUTSIDE and centered below each pin, exactly "1주년 · 동", "3주년 · 은", "5주년 · 금", "10주년 · 플래티넘", in ivory gray. No other text. All four pins must be identical in contour and center, rim material is the only tier distinction.
QUALITY: elegant actual sculpted enamel badge design, restrained detail that reads at 80px, not a flat UI icon, not an emoji, not a generic vector pictogram, no logos, no game trademarks, no tiny illegible inscriptions, no gemstone additions at higher tiers, no random ornamental additions.
SHAPE AND MOTIF: a substantial perfectly circular medallion with a continuous wide stepped double-bevel outer rim. Inside: one elegant four-lobed rosette like four seasonal petals, each petal composed of the same fixed ivory, deep emerald and pale mint enamel sections, around a small champagne-gold four-point star. Four restrained curved enamel quadrants hint at the passing seasons, symmetric balanced jewelry design, no literal seasonal drawings. The circle, petals and star are exactly the same across all four pins. Compact, noble, timeless seal.
